title: The batch runner runs a rolling combine train as a standing duty
ruling: Owner 21:48 CST Nov 13, in runner 10's chat, relayed by the consultant at 21:49 (triage did not see it; the retrospective agrees): the combining should be sort of continuous, so that lane PRs keep getting combined and batched behind the tournament, making the runner a scaling machine; if the idea is sound, relay it to the retrospective and make it part of how a batch runner is briefed or operates. The consultant's reading: a batch closes when its real PR is built and linted; later hand-ins join the next batch; clashing members leave by name; each merge report gives members in, left out, clash rate, dry-round, lint and CI minutes; review after 3 batches against lone merges. Homes: decision session-tiers and the project-ops batch-runner template, via a lane. Merges stay serial. Filed as step batch-runner-rolling-train. Part 2, owner 21:52 CST, relayed by the consultant at 21:52 (triage did not see it): a batch can close, but with batch 1 in CI, batch 2 waiting for batch 1 to merge, batch 3 waiting for batch 2, and batch 4 waiting for batch 3, batches 3 and 4 can also keep combining, even if their lints ran, since there is time until CI finishes on main; maybe not batch 2, because it is next in line. The consultant's reading: the batch in CI and the next in line are frozen; every batch behind them keeps folding into one.
quote: it should be sorta continuous tho, ie yes u do all this and atop it lane prs keep getting combined and batching and batching basically having u become a true scaling machine - if u find this idea sound relay it to retro and ask for it to be part of how a batch runner is briefed and or operates standingly shd this be sound thinking | 21:52 CST: "i think yes a batch can close but lets say theres batch 1 in ci, batch 2 waiting for the batch 1 to merge in so it can merge, batch 3 waiting for batch 2, batch 4 waiting for batch 3 — so forth, i do think theres a case that batch 3 and batch 4 also take the time to just combine too even if they did run their lints like fuck it combine again given theres time till ci finishes on main, maybe not batch 2 tho bc its next in line — does that make sense? how the scale can be super strong in a sense"
source: Consultant 21:49 CST Nov 13 (quoting the owner via runner 10); filed by triage. Part 2: consultant 21:52 CST.
